items.text:
The plan’s shared perception and audit pipeline is implemented in the checkout: canonical observations, SAM3.1 and DWPose integration, shared transforms and model adapters, racket geometry, and runtime transport fixes. The three scene, 16-frame pilot completed on gpu5.

The pilot found unresolved racket-mask failures, so I kept the training manifest inactive and added per-scene quarantine decisions in [sam31_pilot_visual_review_v1.json](/Users/manu/Desktop/PointStream/manifests/sam31_pilot_visual_review_v1.json). I also added an idempotent finalizer at [finalize_sam31_manifest.py](/Users/manu/Desktop/PointStream/scripts/finalize_sam31_manifest.py).

**One external step remains:** fleet revalidation rejected attempts to apply those annotations to the completed run; the latest failure was DNS resolution. No remote files were changed, so the external manifest still predates the review annotations. The rerun command and status are recorded in [data.md](/Users/manu/Desktop/PointStream/docs/areas/data.md). Promotion also remains gated on transmitting pose and racket geometry, regenerating eligible splits, and completing training smokes.

The required fleet and monitor tests passed, along with the focused perception, transport, and finalizer tests.
